paye band 2 rate: PAYE second band rate is 8% on income between TZS 270,001 and TZS 520,000
paye penalty rate: Late PAYE remittance penalty is 2.5% per month of unpaid amount

paye personal relief: Tanzania has NO separate PAYE personal relief deduction. The 0% band on first TZS 270,000/month IS the effective tax-free amount. Both TZS 26,000 and TZS 27,000 'personal relief' figures are WRONG.

paye p9 deadline: The annual employment-income withholding certificate is due by 30 January of the following year (Income Tax Act Cap.332, s.85(3)(b)). 'Form P9' is Kenyan (KRA) terminology -- Tanzania's TRA has no form by that name; do not use it.

p45 not tanzanian: Form P45 does not exist in Tanzania -- it is a UK payroll form. Tanzania's actual equivalent, on employment termination, is the annual employment-income withholding certificate (Income Tax Act Cap.332 s.85(3)(b)) -- there is no 'P9' form name in Tanzanian law either; 'P9' is Kenyan (KRA) terminology, the same defect already found and corrected in this project's paye_p9_deadline fact.
SDL, ambayo huitwa pia "mafunzo": kiwango cha mafunzo ni asilimia tatu na nusu (asilimia 3.5) ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Si asilimia 4, si asilimia 2.
sdl full name: SDL stands for Skills Development Levy — NOT Service Delivery Levy and NOT short-term disability leave
Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Wafanyakazi 10 hasa wanalipa SDL (wako ndani). Si 11, si 4.
sdl payer: SDL is paid by the employer only — NOT deducted from employee wages
NSSF: mwajiri analipa asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa mfanyakazi kila mwezi. Tovuti sahihi ni nssf.go.tz (si nssf.or.tz).
NSSF jumla: asilimia 20 ya mshahara (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Tovuti sahihi ni nssf.go.tz (si nssf.or.tz).
nssf penalty: NSSF late payment penalty is 5% per month of unpaid contributions

nssf retirement age: NSSF pensionable (retirement) age is 60 (Cap.50 s.2, definition of 'pensionable age'). Early retirement is available from age 55 to ANY insured person within 5 years of pensionable age who has paid at least 180 monthly contributions (ss.25(c), 29) -- this is a GENERAL early-retirement provision, NOT a mining-sector-specific rate. Minimum 180 months (15 years) of contributions is required for a retirement pension (s.25(b)).

vat standard rate: Tanzania's GENERAL VAT standard rate is 18% — unchanged since 2015 (VAT Act, Cap.148, s.5(1)). It was NEVER 14%. EXCEPTION: effective 1 September 2025 (Finance Act 2025), a narrower 16% rate applies specifically to B2C taxable supplies made to a person in Mainland Tanzania who is NOT VAT-registered, where payment is made through a bank or electronic payment system approved by the Commissioner General — this is a transaction-specific carve-out, not a general rate change, and does not apply to B2B, exports, or cash transactions.

vat reduced rates: Tanzania does NOT have reduced VAT rates of 5% or 10% for any product category (food, electricity, etc.) — there is no such thing as a category-based reduced VAT rate. The only rates are 18% standard, 0% zero-rated, and exempt (no VAT). SEPARATELY, a narrower 16% rate applies to a specific TRANSACTION TYPE, not a product category: B2C taxable supplies to a person in Mainland Tanzania who is NOT VAT-registered, paid through a bank or electronic payment system approved by the Commissioner General, effective 1 Sep 2025 (Finance Act 2025). This does not contradict 'no 5%/10% category rates' — it is a payment-channel/customer-type carve-out on top of the standard rate, not a reduced rate for a good or service category.
vat registration threshold: VAT registration threshold is TZS 200,000,000 per year OR TZS 100,000,000 per 6 months

vat withholding goods: VAT withholding on goods is 3% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 3% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 15%.

vat withholding services: VAT withholding on services is 6% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 6% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 12% (the statute states this 12% expressly).
gn487a nature: GN487A is a BUSINESS PROHIBITION ORDER listing 15 activities non-citizens cannot conduct. It is NOT about immigration or residence permits.
gn487a effective date: GN 487A came into effect on 28 July 2025
Faini kwa mgeni (raia wa kigeni) anayevunja GN487A: si chini ya TZS 10,000,000 (milioni kumi), na/au kifungo miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa.
Adhabu kwa raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni kukiuka GN487A: faini si zaidi ya TZS 5,000,000 (milioni tano), au kifungo si zaidi ya miezi 3.
Kukopesha, kukodisha au kukabidhi leseni yako ya biashara kwa mgeni ni kosa chini ya GN487A. Raia anayekopesha leseni yake kwa mgeni anaadhibiwa kama msaidizi wa mgeni.
gn605a effective date: GN 605A Private Sector Wage Order came into effect on 1 January 2026
gn605a average increase: GN 605A average increase is 33.4% from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month

royalties wht rate: The DEFAULT withholding tax rate on royalty payments is 15% for BOTH residents and non-residents (Income Tax Act Cap.332 First Schedule para 4(b), via s.82). TWO CARVE-OUTS exist: royalties for cinematographic films/video tapes/sound recordings are 10% (added by Finance Act 2022 s.72(b)(i)); royalties paid to a resident sports entity or the Tanzania Football Federation are 5% (added by Finance Act 2024 s.46(b)(i)).
provisional tax instalments: Provisional tax is paid in FOUR equal instalments at end of months 3, 6, 9, and 12 from start of financial year

Kampuni yenye hasara miaka mitatu mfululizo hulipa kodi ya chini (AMT) ya asilimia 1 ya mauzo ya mwaka wa tatu, tangu Julai 2025 (awali ilikuwa asilimia 0.5). Haitumiki kwa kampuni za kilimo, afya, elimu, wala kampuni za usindikaji chai hadi Juni 2027.
commissioner objection deadline: TRA Commissioner must determine an objection within 6 months from date of admission — NOT 90 days
trab appeal two steps: TRAB appeal requires TWO steps: (1) Notice of Intention within 30 days AND (2) Statement of Appeal within 45 days

objection deposit requirement: Before a TRA objection to a tax assessment is admitted, the taxpayer must pay the HIGHER of the undisputed tax OR one-third of the assessed tax. This payment is due CONCURRENTLY with lodging the objection -- i.e., within the same 30-day period allowed for filing the objection itself (Tax Administration Act, Cap.438 R.E.2023, s.62(7)-(9)) -- NOT on a separate 15-day clock.
objection extension statutory right: Extension of the 30-day objection period is a STATUTORY RIGHT — NOT very rare. Apply within 7 days before expiry.

stamp duty property transfer: Stamp duty on transfer/conveyance of land or buildings is TIERED: 0.5% on the first TZS 100,000 of consideration/market value, then 1% on the value in excess of TZS 100,000 (Stamp Duty Act, Cap.189, Schedule, Article 22(b) 'CONVEYANCE') -- NOT a flat 1%.
permit class b employed: Class B Residence Permit is for EMPLOYED EXPATRIATES working for companies — NOT for investors
permit class a investor: Class A Residence Permit is for SELF-EMPLOYED FOREIGN INVESTORS — NOT Class B

permit class c categories: Class C Residence Permit is for researchers, retired persons, missionaries, former employees winding up affairs, individuals attending medical treatment, volunteers, intern students, parties/witnesses in court, buyers of real estate, and other similar categories -- NOT for employed foreign workers.

Kodi ya kampuni Tanzania ni asilimia 30 kwa kampuni za kawaida. Kampuni zilizoorodheshwa DSE (Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam) zenye angalau asilimia 25 ya hisa zao kwa umma hulipa asilimia 25 kwa miaka mitatu tangu tarehe ya kuorodheshwa.
wht deadline: Withholding tax must be remitted within 7 DAYS after end of the calendar month — NOT 7th of following month
loss carryforward finance act 2024: After 4 consecutive years of tax losses only 60% of year 5 income can be offset against losses (Finance Act 2024)
brela share transfer legal effect: Share transfer without BRELA notification MAY LACK LEGAL EFFECT AGAINST THIRD PARTIES — it is not absolutely void
tmda replaces tfda: TMDA (Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority) is the current name — TFDA no longer exists

brave search blocked tanzania: Brave Search API is blocked in Tanzania. TRA required Brave Software to register as non-resident electronic service provider. Brave blocked Tanzania access instead of registering.
paye all bands sequence: PAYE bands (monthly): 0% up to TZS 270K | 8% TZS 270K-520K | 20% TZS 520K-760K | 25% TZS 760K-1M | 30% above TZS 1M

paye nonresident flat rate: Non-resident employees pay PAYE at a flat 15% rate — NOT the progressive bands. This is a final withholding tax (Income Tax Act Cap.332, First Schedule para 4(a)(ii), the rate table for section 81 'Withholding by employers' -- a resident withholdee follows 'the rates prescribed in regulations' i.e. the First Schedule para 1 progressive bands; a non-resident withholdee is flat 15%. Para 4 sits under Division II of Part VII, the final-withholding-payments framework, which is the statutory basis for calling this withholding final rather than an on-account payment.)

Naweza kufuta, kufunga au kuondoa kampuni yangu iliyosajiliwa kwenye daftari la BRELA? Ndiyo — HAKUNA sharti la "kumaliza muda" kwanza, kwa sababu kampuni haina muda maalum. Kampuni isipowasilisha ritani za mwaka (annual returns) inaweza kuhesabiwa haifanyi kazi (defunct) na kufutwa kwenye Daftari la Makampuni: Msajili hutoa notisi ya siku 30, kisha jina hufutwa chini ya Sheria ya Makampuni (Sura 212). Kurejesha kampuni iliyofutwa kunahitaji Mahakama Kuu.
wcf new employer registration: A new employer must register with WCF within 30 days of hiring their first employee

wcf disease reporting deadline: Occupational disease reporting to WCF is a TWO-STAGE chain, not a flat 7-day deadline. Per the Workers Compensation Regulations, 2016 (GN 185/2016), Reg.16: the EMPLOYEE must notify the EMPLOYER within 14 working days of diagnosis (Reg.16(1)); the EMPLOYER must then notify WCF within 7 working days of RECEIVING that employee notice (Reg.16(2)) -- so the true worst-case window from diagnosis to WCF notification is up to 21 working days, NOT 7. Workplace death must be reported to WCF within 12 months (Reg.17(2)). Compensation claim must be filed within 12 months of accident or disease discovery (Reg.19(1)).
gn605a increment range: GN 605A individual sector increments range from TZS 20,000 (lowest sector) to TZS 195,000 (highest sector) per month
unresolved items:
wht director fees: WHT on director fees (non-full-time directors) is 15% — a single rate for both residents and non-residents. Source: TRA.go.tz withholding tax page.

wcf accident reporting: Employer must notify WCF of a workplace accident within 7 WORKING DAYS — via WCF online portal (portal.wcf.go.tz). Different deadline for occupational illness. Source: WCF portal.
wcf accident reporting deadline: 7 working days from date of accident. Source: Workers Compensation Act / portal.wcf.go.tz
OSHA Tanzania: kila mwajiri lazima asajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA. Sheria inahusu maeneo yote ya kazi bila kikomo cha idadi ya wafanyakazi.
dse 25 rate three years only: DSE 25% CIT rate applies for THREE YEARS ONLY from listing date
permit class d does not exist: Tanzania has NO Class D permit — only Class A (investor), Class B (employed expatriate), Class C (researcher/voluntary)
gn487a transitional provision: Non-citizens with valid licences at 28 July 2025 may continue until licence expiry. No renewal permitted. No new licences issued for prohibited activities.

Kizingiti cha kuanza kutumia mashine ya EFD: mauzo ya TZS 11,000,000 (milioni kumi na moja) kwa mwaka. Si TZS 200,000,000 — hiyo ni kizingiti cha kusajili VAT, si EFD. Biashara zote zilizosajiliwa VAT hutumia EFD bila kujali kiwango cha mauzo.

Duka dogo au biashara ndogo yenye mauzo madogo, je inahitaji mashine ya risiti (EFD)? Si lazima. Si kila biashara inalazimika kutumia mashine ya risiti za kielektroniki (EFD): biashara ndogo yenye mauzo chini ya TZS 11,000,000 kwa mwaka na isiyosajiliwa VAT inaweza kutumia risiti za mkono badala ya mashine ya EFD. Waliosajiliwa VAT na wenye mauzo ya TZS 11,000,000 au zaidi ndio hulazimika kutumia mashine ya risiti za EFD.

gn487a visa revocation: Visa and resident-permit revocation is a MANDATORY consequence upon conviction under GN487A s.3(3)(a) -- the Order's own text says a convicted non-citizen 'shall be liable to' a fine or imprisonment 'AND revocation of visa and resident permit.' It only attaches on CONVICTION, not on mere accusation, investigation, or GN487A's existence.

vat withholding remittance deadline: VAT withholding remitted to TRA within 10 days after the end of each tax period (WEF 1 July 2026, Finance Act 2026 s.95, repealing and replacing VAT Act s.71(5)). Before 1 July 2026 the deadline was the 20th of the following month, same as the VAT return (Finance Act 2025's original s.71(5): remit 'at the time when the value added tax return is due to be filed') -- that was correct THEN, it is not correct NOW. A withholding VAT statement (a new, separate filing obligation, s.71(6)) is also due within 10 days of the month following the tax period.
vat late registration penalty: Penalty for failure to register VAT: fine up to TZS 200,000 AND/OR imprisonment 2-12 months PLUS interest on unpaid VAT. NO 2.5% monthly rate exists in the VAT Act.
NSSF inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 10 ya mwezi unaofuata.

paye bands monthly 2025 26: PAYE monthly bands 2025/26: Band 1: 0-270,000=0%; Band 2: 270,001-520,000=8%; Band 3: 520,001-760,000=20%; Band 4: 760,001-1,000,000=25%; Band 5: above 1,000,000=30%. No personal relief of TZS 26,000 exists.

vat withholding formula correct: VAT withholding rate applies to the CONSIDERATION (invoice value exclusive of VAT), NOT the VAT amount. The standard 18% VAT is split between TRA and the supplier. Goods: 3% x consideration withheld, supplier receives 15% x consideration (3 + 15 = 18). Services: 6% x consideration withheld, supplier receives 12% x consideration (6 + 12 = 18). Example goods: TZS 5M invoice, VAT = TZS 900,000; withholding = 3% x 5,000,000 = TZS 150,000; supplier receives TZS 750,000 of the VAT. Example services: TZS 3M invoice, VAT = TZS 540,000; withholding = 6% x 3,000,000 = TZS 180,000; supplier receives TZS 360,000 of the VAT.

wcf threshold no minimum: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) applies to ALL employers in Mainland Tanzania from the first employee. There is NO minimum employee count threshold. Contrast with SDL which requires 10+ employees. WCF: 0.5% of gross cash emoluments, from employee 1. SDL: 3.5% of gross cash emoluments, from employee 10.
WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): mwajiri analipa asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara yote kila mwezi. Si kiasi kisichobadilika — inategemea mishahara.

wcf paid to fund not tra: WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) contributions are paid by the employer DIRECTLY to the Fund via its portal (portal.wcf.go.tz), NOT to TRA. WCF and SDL are different levies collected by different institutions: WCF = 0.5% of gross emoluments, paid to the WCF Fund, funds workplace-injury compensation; SDL = 3.5% of gross emoluments (employers with 10+ employees), paid to TRA, funds skills development. The employee does NOT contribute to WCF — it is a criminal offence for an employer to deduct a WCF contribution from an employee.

OSHA na WCF ni taasisi mbili tofauti. OSHA husajili mahali pa kazi (kifungu 16, Sheria ya OSHA Na.5 ya 2003), hukagua, na hutoa leseni ya utii kila mwaka — OSHA HAILIPI fidia ya ajali. Fidia ya ajali na magonjwa ya kazini hulipwa na WCF (mwajiri huchangia 0.5% ya mishahara). Usajili wa OSHA na wa WCF ni tofauti; vyote vinahitajika. WCF huanza tangu mfanyakazi wa kwanza — HAKUNA kizingiti cha wafanyakazi wawili.

Nina wafanyakazi wawili tu (au mmoja) dukani — je bado najisajili mahali fulani? Ndiyo. OSHA husajili maeneo YOTE ya kazi bila kikomo cha idadi ya wafanyakazi, na WCF huanza tangu mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Idadi ndogo ya wafanyakazi HAIONDOI wajibu wa kujisajili OSHA na WCF (mfuko wa fidia).

vat threshold 200m july2024 increase: VAT registration threshold was increased from TZS 100M to TZS 200M effective 1 JULY 2023 (NOT July 2024) by Government Notice No. 448Y of 2023, amending Regulation 14 of the VAT (General) Regulations 2015. Current thresholds: TZS 200M per 12 months OR TZS 100M per any 6-month rolling period (the 6-month figure is structurally half of the 12-month figure, per VAT Act s.28(2)(b)). Zanzibar has its own, separately-administered VAT threshold, reported by the Zanzibar Revenue Authority's own site as TZS 100,000,000 under the Zanzibar VAT Act No. 4 of 1998 -- sourced to ZRA directly, but not yet pinned to a specific section/GN. Any pair showing TZS 100M/year or TZS 50M/6mo mainland is citing pre-July-2023 rules.

GN605A effective date: GN 605A (Government Notice No. 605A) gazetted 13 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026. Revokes and replaces the Minimum Wage Order 2022 in its entirety. The 2022 order has NO force after 31 December 2025.
Kima cha chini cha mshahara (GN 605A): hakina kiwango kimoja kwa nchi nzima — kila sekta ina chake, sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46. Mkulima / sekta ya kilimo ina kiwango chake tofauti na sekta nyingine.

GN605A rate range: GN 605A monthly rates range from TZS 80,000 (other domestic workers) to TZS 765,900 (energy sector international companies). Agricultural/general floor is TZS 175,000. Any sector not explicitly specified in the Order defaults to TZS 175,000 per month.

GN605A key sector rates: Selected confirmed GN 605A monthly minimum rates: Agricultural (crop/animal): TZS 175,000. Hotel 5-star/4-star: TZS 375,000. Hotel bars/restaurants: TZS 195,000. Mining (prospecting): TZS 695,000. Energy international: TZS 765,900. Commercial banks: TZS 733,000. Construction Class I: TZS 515,000. Telecommunication: TZS 644,000. Industrial: TZS 200,000.

OSHA penalties: Failure to register or obtain OSHA compliance licence: fine TZS 1,000,000 to TZS 5,000,000 OR imprisonment up to 12 months OR both. Continuing offence: additional TZS 100,000 per day. Source: OHS Act No. 5 of 2003.

VAT withholding base disputed: RESOLVED (2026-07-25) by primary legislation: the base is the CONSIDERATION (invoice value exclusive of VAT), not the VAT amount. Finance Act 2025 s.124 (VAT Act s.5(5)) splits the 18% standard rate — the withholding agent withholds 3% (goods) / 6% (services) of the supply and the supplier receives 15% / 12% respectively (3+15 = 6+12 = 18). The earlier 'dispute' arose from practitioner summaries loosely phrasing the split as '3% of the VAT'; the VAT-amount reading is inconsistent with the statute's express 12% supplier share for services. Training pairs SHOULD now use the consideration formula. See vat_withholding_formula_correct.

NSSF split triggers: NSSF total is always 20% of gross wage. Three valid employer-employee split arrangements: (a) 10% employer + 10% employee — standard default; (b) 15% employer + 5% employee — employer elects to contribute more; (c) 20% employer + 0% employee — employer pays the full 20%, employee pays nothing. Employee share must never exceed 10%. All three arrangements are legal under the NSSF Act.

BRELA fees hedge: BRELA registration and filing fees change periodically via ministerial order. Training pairs must direct users to brela.go.tz or the ORS portal for current fees rather than stating specific TZS amounts. The annual return filing fee has been approximately TZS 22,000 but this must be verified before quoting in any business context.

vat withholding certificate timing: VAT withholding certificate must be issued NOT LATER THAN the date on which VAT becomes payable under section 15 of the VAT Act — NOT on the 20th of the following month. The 20th deadline applies to filing the VAT return and remitting the withheld amount, which are separate obligations. A withholding agent must issue the certificate in an approved system format containing: TIN, registration number, supply description, consideration amount, withholding rate and withholding amount.

brela partnership registration: A general partnership (ushirikiano wa kibiashara) in Tanzania can be registered with BRELA under the Business Names Registration Act or incorporated as a Limited Partnership. Required documents typically include: partnership deed, names and addresses of all partners, business name, nature of business, TIN for each partner. Exact current procedure and fees must be verified at brela.go.tz or via the ORS portal (ors.brela.go.tz) as requirements change by ministerial order.

brela business structures: BRELA registers businesses in THREE main legal forms: (1) sole proprietorship / individual — registered as a business name under the Business Names (Registration) Act Cap.213; (2) partnership (firm) — also registered as a business name under Cap.213 (a firm is two or more persons in partnership); (3) limited liability company — incorporated under the Companies Act Cap.212. The choice between a business name and a company depends on the desired legal structure and liability, NOT on the number of employees or the amount of capital — there is no employee-count or capital threshold that forces incorporation. BRELA separately administers trademarks, patents and industrial designs (intellectual property); these are NOT business structures.

osha licence renewal frequency: OSHA workplace compliance certificate (cheti cha usajilishaji) renewal frequency is not explicitly stated on osha.go.tz. The OHS Act 2003 requires employers to maintain workplace registration. In practice OSHA conducts annual risk assessments and inspections. Training pairs must direct employers to osha.go.tz to confirm current renewal period rather than stating a specific interval.

nssf employer registration deadline: Every employer in Tanzania must register with NSSF before or within a reasonable period of commencing business. The NSSF Act Cap. 50 imposes a registration obligation but the exact number of days is not confirmed from the primary source (nssf.go.tz was unreachable during verification). Training pairs must direct employers to nssf.go.tz to confirm current registration deadline and avoid stating a specific day count.

efd approved supplier verification: To verify that an EFD supplier/distributor (msambazaji) is TRA-approved, businesses should check tra.go.tz/page/efd-vfd-suppliers, which publishes a "List of Approved EFD/VFD Suppliers" PDF. TRA defines an approved supplier as a certified entity "by commissioner General for import, distribute and sell EFD/VFD, install, configure, integrate, train users" and provide related support. Businesses should only purchase EFD machines from TRA-approved dealers -- purchasing from unapproved suppliers may result in the machine not being activated by TRA.
OSHA hufanya ukaguzi wa lazima kila mwaka (mara moja kwa mwaka) katika maeneo yote ya kazi Tanzania.

OSHA safety officer threshold: Occupational Health and Safety Act Cap.297 s.11(1) requires an employer with MORE THAN 20 EMPLOYEES to designate a 'health and safety representative' -- an existing employee given this role, NOT a professionally hired/dedicated 'safety officer'. Ratios for how many representatives: 1 per 100 employees in shops/offices, 1 per 50 in a factory/other workplace (s.11(4)). An OSHA inspector may also COMPEL designation even at 4 or fewer employees (s.11(5)). A safety committee (s.13) is required once 2+ representatives exist. Do NOT phrase this as 'must hire a safety officer above N employees' -- it is a representative/committee scheme built from existing staff, triggered at >20 employees as the general rule, with inspector discretion below that.

BRELA COSOTA split: Intellectual property in Tanzania is split between two bodies. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) administers: trademarks (alama za biashara), patents (hati miliki), and industrial designs (miundo ya viwanda). COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) administers: copyright and neighbouring rights (haki za ubunifu na haki jirani). There is NO body called ORT — ort.go.tz does not exist as a Tanzanian IP registry.

SDL source law: SDL (Skills Development Levy) is imposed under Section 14 of the Vocational Education Training Act, Cap. 82. It is collected by TRA. Rate: 3.5% of gross cash emoluments (reduced from 4% by Finance Act 2023, effective 1 July 2023). Applies to employers with 10 or more employees on Mainland Tanzania.

VAT zero rated vs exempt input VAT: Zero-rated supplies are taxable at 0% VAT rate — suppliers CAN claim input VAT on their purchases. Exempt supplies are not subject to VAT at all — suppliers CANNOT claim input VAT on their purchases. These are fundamentally different categories. The model previously inverted this rule (eval_017 failure: stated zero-rated businesses cannot claim input VAT).

gn487a mgeni cap357 definition: GN487A defines 'non-citizen' by reference to the Tanzania Citizenship Act Cap.357 R.E.2023. Cap.357 recognises three citizen categories: citizen by birth, citizen by descent, and citizen by naturalisation. A person holding Tanzanian citizenship under any of these three categories is NOT a non-citizen for GN487A purposes. Whether dual nationals holding a Tanzanian passport qualify as citizens depends on Cap.357 — this is a legal interpretation that must be verified with an immigration lawyer.

gn487a msaidizi definition: Under GN487A, a 'msaidizi' (facilitator) is a Tanzanian citizen who assists or aids a non-citizen to carry out any of the 15 prohibited business activities. This includes but may not be limited to lending their name, business licence, or identity to allow a non-citizen to operate a prohibited business. Penalty for msaidizi: TZS 5,000,000 fine OR imprisonment not exceeding 3 months. The facilitator and the non-citizen are BOTH penalised.

Kuoa au kuolewa na raia wa Tanzania HAKUKUPI msamaha wa GN487A wala uraia. Mgeni aliyeoa Mtanzania bado ni mgeni na hawezi kufanya biashara ya rejareja iliyozuiliwa. Tafuta ushauri wa wakili wa uhamiaji.

vat withholding buyer remits directly: The withholding agent (qualifying buyer / mnunuzi anayehitimu) remits VAT withholding DIRECTLY to TRA — not through the supplier's VAT return. TRA states: 'the withholding agent shall withhold 3%/6% and remit it to the Commissioner General.' The supplier receives a VAT Withholding Certificate as proof that the withheld amount has been remitted, which it then subtracts as output tax withheld in its VAT return (Finance Act 2025 s.71 amendment). The formula base is the consideration (invoice value excl. VAT) — see vat_withholding_formula_correct.

efd tra closure authority: TRA has enforcement authority against businesses that repeatedly fail to issue EFD receipts. Enforcement actions can include: written warnings, imposition of fines, suspension of EFD device/licence, and closure of business premises (Tax Administration Act Cap.438 s.64 -- "Restraint of assets" -- grants the Commissioner General power to mark, lock up or seal any building, room or place, triggered by breach of the EFD-issuance requirement, among other tax-law breaches).
SDL inalipwa ifikapo siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata.
company name reservation fee: company name reservation fee: 50,000 TZS
company name change fee: company name change fee: 22,000 TZS
BRELA: ukichelewa kuwasilisha ritani (annual return) ya kampuni, faini ni TZS 2,500 kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa.
BRELA: ada ya kuwasilisha ritani (annual return) ya kampuni kila mwaka ni TZS 22,000.
certified copy agreement law constitution fee: certified copy agreement law constitution fee: 750 USD

act section 12: Foreign/external companies carrying on business in Tanzania are governed by Part XIII (ss.320-328) of the Companies Act, Cap.212 -- NOT Part XII, which governs winding up of unregistered companies (ss.314-319). This includes the obligation to deliver documents/balance sheets to the Registrar and the late-filing penalty regime.

risk assessment frequency: Workplace risk assessment (Occupational Health and Safety Act Cap.297, s.60) applies specifically to factories/workplaces involving HAZARDOUS processes, hazardous equipment, or hazardous chemicals likely to cause adverse health effects or serious damage -- NOT a universal requirement for every workplace. Required frequency: at least once a year ('mara moja kwa mwaka'), OR more often whenever circumstances make it necessary. The assessment must be carried out by an approved inspection authority, not by the employer alone.
Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT: mauzo ya TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12.
Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT: mauzo ya TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6.

vat registration notification deadline commissioner: When the Commissioner General registers a person for VAT who failed to apply despite being liable, the person must be notified within 14 days of the registration -- NOT the 30-day figure that applies to a liable person's own application deadline
vat return submission deadline: VAT return for domestic (non-import) supplies is due on or before the 20th day of the month following the tax period -- same date VAT itself becomes payable
form number payment credit slip: SDL payments are made using form ITX 300.01.E, the Employment Taxes Payment Credit Slip
late payment penalty rate: 2 %
workers compensation rules citation: Workers Compensation Regulations, 2016 (Government Notice No. 185 of 2016, gazetted 27 May 2016) -- Kanuni za Sheria ya Fidia kwa Wafanyakazi za mwaka 2016

workers compensation amendment rules citation: Workers Compensation (Amendment) Regulations, 2021 (Government Notice No. 668, published 10 September 2021) -- Kanuni za Sheria ya Fidia kwa Wafanyakazi Marekebisho ya mwaka 2021

minimum directors: A company under the Companies Act Cap.212 must have a minimum of 2 directors. Directors are PERSONS (natural persons appointed to the board), NOT 'employees' -- a director need not be, and often is not, an employee of the company. This minimum-of-2 figure is confirmed via secondary corroboration for both private and public companies (s.186, 'Number of directors'); whether the 2021 amendment permitting single-shareholder private companies (s.26A) also permits a single-DIRECTOR company has NOT been confirmed and should not be assumed either way.

minimum shareholders: A private company under the Companies Act Cap.212 requires a minimum of 2 shareholders (members) -- EXCEPT that since the 2021 amendment (s.26A, 'Single shareholder'), a private company may now be formed or continued with just 1 shareholder as an exception to the general rule. A PUBLIC company requires a minimum of 7 shareholders, not 2. Shareholders are PERSONS/MEMBERS, NOT 'employees' -- a shareholder need not be an employee of the company.
registration certificate processing time: 3 days -- company registration certificate processing time

annual return form number: Form No. 128 -- annual return submission form. The NAME is a legacy label from the original Companies Act 2002 numbering: the annual-return DUTY itself now sits at s.131 of the Companies Act Cap.212 R.E.2023 (28-day filing deadline from the return date), not s.128 -- current s.128 is 'Regulations as to branch register', an unrelated provision. Do not 'correct' the form's name to match the current section number; BRELA and practitioners still call it Form 128.
beneficial owner information penalty maximum: 10,000,000 TZS -- maximum penalty for beneficial-owner non-disclosure

business name maintenance fee: The BRELA annual business-name maintenance/operating fee ('ada ya uendeshaji', paid every year to keep a registered business name active) is TZS 5,000. This is separate from the initial application/registration fee, which is TZS 15,000.

name similarity threshold: BRELA does not use a numeric similarity percentage as a legal rule for rejecting a proposed company name. The actual test (Companies Rules 2006 rr.2-3, under Companies Act Cap.212; and the Business Names (Registration) Act Cap.213) is QUALITATIVE: a name is rejected if it is 'identical with or similar to' an existing name such that it is 'likely to mislead the public,' or is otherwise undesirable, at the Registrar's discretion. A commonly-cited '50%' figure is an ORS (Online Registration System) on-screen UI similarity indicator, not a codified legal threshold.

trademark renewal period: UNCONFIRMED: the trademark registration/renewal term length in Tanzania (previously stated as 'saba years'/7 years) could not be sourced. BRELA's own fee schedule confirms a renewal fee (TZS 30,000) and Form TM/SM 9 'Renewal of Registration of a Mark' exist, but does not state the term length. tanzlii.org (the Trade and Service Marks Act/Regulations primary text) was unreachable. Do not assert a specific number of years until this is confirmed against primary text.
application fee patent: 12,000 TZS -- patent application fee

patent term: A Tanzanian patent's BASE term is 10 years from the filing date (Patents (Registration) Act, Cap.217, s.39(1)). The owner/licensee may apply for up to TWO separate 5-year extensions (application required 1-12 months before each expiry, and only if the invention is being 'worked' in Tanzania or a legitimate reason for not working it is proven), reaching a MAXIMUM of 20 years only if both extensions are sought and granted. A patent that lapses at year 10 with no extension application simply expires -- 20 years is NOT an automatic term.
company director minimum age: A person shall not be capable of being appointed as a director of a company if, at the time of appointment, they have not attained the age of eighteen years

course fee: UNCONFIRMED: '250,000 TZS' does not match any OSHA training course fee actually checked on osha.go.tz -- 'Safe Use of Chemicals at Work', 'OHS in Construction Industry', and 'Safety and Health in Oil and Gas Industry' are all priced at TZS 300,000. Which course (if any) '250,000 TZS' refers to could not be identified.
registration certificate processing time new: 1 days
compliance license processing time old: 28 days

vat deferment limit date: VAT deferment on IMPORTED capital goods ceased to apply from 30 June 2026 (Finance Act 2023 s.65(b), amending VAT Act Cap.148 s.11(1) proviso: "deferment on the imported capital goods shall cease to apply on the 30th day of June, 2026"). This is now a PAST cutoff, not an upcoming deadline. Deferment on LOCALLY MANUFACTURED capital goods is UNAFFECTED by this clause and continues under the same s.11(1), which has no cutoff for that branch.

vat deferment threshold percentage: VAT deferment on imported capital goods (VAT Act Cap.148 s.11) is available only if the applicant's turnover IS or IS EXPECTED TO BE at least 90% taxable supplies -- this is an ELIGIBILITY TEST on the importer's business mix, not a percentage of VAT that gets deferred.
vat deferment minimum value: The minimum VAT payable per unit of imported capital goods for VAT deferment eligibility (VAT Act Cap.148 s.11 scheme) is TZS 10,000,000.
vat deferment form number: The VAT capital-goods deferment application form is ITX 247.02.E, filed online via TanESW

gn487a full legal name: GN 487A is Government Notice No. 487A. Its full legal name is: The Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order, 2025. GN 487A is NOT Government Notice No. 605A. Government Notice No. 605A is a completely different instrument -- the 2026 minimum wage order. Never state that GN 487A's name or number is 605A.

gn487a vs gn605a disambiguation: GN 487A and GN 605A are two DIFFERENT Government Notices and must never be conflated. GN 487A = Government Notice No. 487A = The Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order, 2025 (effective 28 July 2025; bars non-citizens from 15 business activities). GN 605A = Government Notice No. 605A = the Private Sector Minimum Wage Order (gazetted 13 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026; sets minimum wages, revokes the 2022 wage order). Different numbers, different subjects, different Ministries. Asking for GN 487A's name must NOT return 605A, and asking about minimum wage must NOT return 487A.
gn487a legal authority: GN487A is made under the Business Licensing Act (Cap. 101), section 14A(2)
gn487a salon exception: Salon business is prohibited for non-citizens UNLESS conducted in a hotel or for tourism purposes
gn487a prohibited activity 1: Prohibited activity 1: Sale of goods on a wholesale and retail basis, excluding supermarkets, specialised product outlets, and wholesale centers for local producers
gn487a prohibited activity 2: Prohibited activity 2: Mobile money transfers

Kutengeneza au ukarabati wa simu na vifaa vya kielektroniki ni shughuli iliyozuiliwa kwa wasio raia chini ya GN487A. Mgeni hawezi kufanya biashara ya kutengeneza simu. (Prohibited activity 3: repair of mobile phones and electronic devices.)
gn487a prohibited activity 4: Prohibited activity 4: Salon business unless conducted in a hotel or for tourism purposes
gn487a prohibited activity 5: Prohibited activity 5: Home, office and environmental cleanliness
gn487a prohibited activity 6: Prohibited activity 6: Small-scale mining
gn487a prohibited activity 7: Prohibited activity 7: Postal activities and parcel delivery within the country
gn487a prohibited activity 8: Prohibited activity 8: Tour guiding within the country
gn487a prohibited activity 9: Prohibited activity 9: Establishment and operation of radio and television
gn487a prohibited activity 10: Prohibited activity 10: Operation of museums or curio shops
gn487a prohibited activity 11: Prohibited activity 11: Brokerage or agency in businesses and real estate
gn487a prohibited activity 12: Prohibited activity 12: Clearing and forwarding services
gn487a prohibited activity 13: Prohibited activity 13: On-farm crop purchasing operations
gn487a prohibited activity 14: Prohibited activity 14: Ownership or operation of gambling machines or devices, except within casino premises
gn487a prohibited activity 15: Prohibited activity 15: Ownership and operation of micro and small industries
gn487a total prohibited activities: GN487A Schedule lists exactly 15 prohibited business activities for non-citizens
Ukichelewesha kulipa mchango wa NSSF, adhabu (penalty) ni ASILIMIA 5 ya kiasi kisicholipwa.
unpaid contribution penalty frequency: each month or a part of a month null
minimum monthly contributions for retirement pension: 180 monthly contributions
minimum contribution months health insurance: 3 months
minimum monthly contributions maternity benefit: 36 monthly_contributions
duration of maternity cash benefit: 12 weeks
NSSF likizo ya uzazi (maternity benefit): mfanyakazi analipwa 100% ya mshahara wakati wa likizo ya uzazi.
employer notification deadline before retirement: 6 months
fund payment deadline after retirement notification: 60 days
pensionable age: 60 years
fine limit: one hundred thousand TZS
imprisonment term limit: two years
penalty imprisonment non citizen: six months null
penalty fine tanzanian citizen: five million TZS
penalty imprisonment tanzanian citizen: three months null

gn487a shareholder vs operator distinction: GN487A prohibits non-citizens from CONDUCTING or OPERATING the listed business activities. Passive shareholding or investment in a Tanzanian-owned and operated company is not explicitly prohibited by GN487A - the prohibition targets the person carrying out the activity, not the investor. However, a non-citizen who is a shareholder AND actively manages or operates the business would be covered. Consult an immigration lawyer for specific structures.
PAYE kwa mshahara wa TZS 800,000 ni TZS 78,000 kamili. Hii ni jibu la mwisho, si mahesabu ya ziada.
Mfano wa hesabu ya SDL: mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye mshahara TZS 600,000, SDL ni asilimia 3.5 = TZS 21,000. Kwa wafanyakazi 12 wenye mshahara huo huo, SDL jumla ni TZS 252,000 (12 × 21,000).

Kwa wafanyakazi 12 wenye mshahara TZS 600,000 kila mmoja, NSSF jumla ni TZS 1,440,000 (SI TZS 120,000 — hiyo ni kwa mfanyakazi mmoja tu). Hesabu: kila mfanyakazi analipa NSSF ya TZS 120,000 (asilimia 20 ya mshahara wake), kisha zidisha kwa wafanyakazi 12 = TZS 1,440,000 jumla.
business licence expiry 30 june: Every business licence in Tanzania expires on 30 June each year. Leseni ya biashara huisha tarehe 30 Juni kila mwaka, hivyo huhuishwa kila mwaka kabla ya tarehe hiyo.

presumptive tax bands 2022: Kodi ya makadirio (presumptive income tax) kwa mtu binafsi, kwa MAUZO ya mwaka: hadi TZS 4,000,000 = TZS 0; zaidi ya 4,000,000 hadi 7,000,000 = TZS 100,000 (asiyetunza kumbukumbu) au 3% ya mauzo yanayozidi 4,000,000 (anayetunza); zaidi ya 7,000,000 hadi 11,000,000 = TZS 250,000 (asiyetunza) au TZS 90,000 pamoja na 3% ya yanayozidi 7,000,000 (anayetunza); kuanzia 11,000,001 hadi 200,000,000 = 4.0% ya mauzo yote (ilikuwa asilimia 3.5, ilipanda WEF 1 Julai 2026). Pia: mfanyabiashara mpya mwenye TIN aliyoipata kwa ajili ya kuanzisha biashara hii ndani ya miezi 12 anaweza kustahili msamaha wa TZS 0 (hadi TZS 200,000,000 za mauzo) -- LAKINI si wa moja kwa moja, lazima aombe kwa Kamishna na aidhinishwe (First Schedule para 2(4), mpya).

presumptive tax ceiling 100m: Kodi ya makadirio hutumika tu kwa mtu binafsi mwenye mauzo yasiyozidi TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka (ilikuwa TZS 100,000,000, iliongezwa WEF 1 Julai 2026). Zaidi ya hapo hutozwa kodi ya mapato kwa viwango vya kawaida vya mtu binafsi.

presumptive excluded services: Kodi ya makadirio HAITUMIKI kwa wataalamu huru (independent professionals) wala watoa huduma za kitaalamu (technical), uendeshaji (management), ujenzi (construction) na mafunzo (training). Hawa hutozwa kodi kwa viwango vya kawaida vya mtu binafsi.
Kampuni ya kigeni (Section XII) ikichelewa kuwasilisha ritani ya mwaka: faini ni USD 25 kwa kila mwezi (tofauti na kampuni za ndani ambazo hulipa TZS 2,500 kwa mwezi).

Umefungua karakana au sehemu mpya ya kazi? Usajili wa OSHA lazima ufanyike KABLA ya kuanza biashara — hakuna muda wa siku baada ya kufungua. (Kifungu 16(2), Sheria ya Afya na Usalama Mahali pa Kazi Na.5 ya 2003.)

Waajiri/taasisi zisizolipa SDL (msamaha): idara za Serikali, mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa, taasisi za kidiplomasia, Umoja wa Mataifa na taasisi zake, mashirika ya kimataifa ya misaada, taasisi za kidini (kwa shughuli za kiroho tu), taasisi za elimu zilizosajiliwa, mashirika ya misaada (charitable), wanafunzi wa TaESA, na waajiri wa mashambani kwa wafanyakazi wanaolima moja kwa moja.

council service levy is a cap not a rate: Ushuru wa huduma wa halmashauri (service levy): sheria inaweka KIKOMO cha asilimia 0.3 ya mauzo (bila VAT na ushuru wa bidhaa) — si kiwango kimoja cha kitaifa. Kila halmashauri hupanga chake kwa sheria ndogo, na nyingi hutoza chini ya kikomo hicho. Uliza ofisi ya mapato ya halmashauri yako kwa kiwango halisi.

council service levy non corporate conflict: Je mfanyabiashara mmoja mmoja hulipa ushuru wa huduma? Sheria yenyewe inagongana. Kifungu 7(1)(u) cha Cap 290 kinasema hulipwa na "corporate entities au mtu yeyote anayefanya biashara akiwa na leseni", lakini Jedwali la sheria hiyo hiyo linakataza halmashauri kutoza wasio-corporate. Duka la mtu mmoja ni non-corporate. Uliza halmashauri yako na omba maelezo kwa maandishi.

market dues no national amount: Ushuru wa soko au genge ni kiasi gani? Hakuna kiwango kimoja cha kitaifa. Kiasi hupangwa chini ya Sheria ya Masoko (Cap 106) na sheria ndogo za kila halmashauri — zaidi ya halmashauri 180, kila moja na yake, na hubadilika mara kwa mara. Uliza meneja wa soko au ofisi ya mapato ya halmashauri yako.

market dues exemptions: Nani hatozwi ushuru wa soko: Jedwali la Sheria ya Fedha za Serikali za Mitaa (Cap 290) linakataza halmashauri kutoza wakulima wanaouza mazao yao mara kwa mara, magulio yanayosimamiwa na halmashauri za vijiji, na wauzaji wadogo wa vyakula vilivyopikwa kama maandazi na samaki wa kukaanga. Ukiwa katika makundi haya na unadaiwa, omba maelezo kwa maandishi.

business licence fee national schedule local collection: Leseni ya biashara inagharimu kiasi gani? Ada imepangwa KITAIFA chini ya Sheria ya Leseni za Biashara, lakini leseni hutolewa na kukusanywa na halmashauri, na halmashauri hairuhusiwi kutoza zaidi ya ada iliyopangwa. Ada hutegemea aina ya biashara na eneo — jiji/manispaa, wilaya/mji, au kijiji — na kama ni leseni kuu au ya tawi. Uliza halmashauri yako kwa ada ya aina yako.

Ada za alama ya biashara (trademark) BRELA: kusajili alama moja TZS 60,000; kuhuisha (renewal) TZS 30,000; mfululizo wa alama — ya kwanza TZS 60,000, zinazofuata TZS 30,000; kuhuisha mfululizo — ya kwanza TZS 30,000, zinazofuata TZS 10,000; taarifa ya pingamizi TZS 60,000; kujibu pingamizi TZS 50,000; kusikiliza pingamizi TZS 70,000; maelezo ya uamuzi TZS 50,000; kusajili mmiliki mpya TZS 50,000; kubadili mmiliki au mtumiaji TZS 50,000; kubadili anwani ya biashara TZS 20,000; kuvunja ubia TZS 50,000; kurejeshewa ada TZS 30,000; ada ya nyongeza kanuni 54 TZS 30,000; kiingizo kingine chochote TZS 10,000.

Kusajili kampuni gharama ya kuanzia ni TZS 95,000; kuhifadhi jina ni TZS 50,000. Ngazi za ada kwa mtaji wa hisa (share capital): hadi TZS 1,000,000 ni TZS 95,000; zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000 hadi TZS 5,000,000 ni TZS 175,000; zaidi ya TZS 5,000,000 hadi TZS 20,000,000 ni TZS 260,000; zaidi ya TZS 20,000,000 hadi TZS 50,000,000 ni TZS 290,000; zaidi ya TZS 50,000,000 ni TZS 440,000. Kampuni isiyo na mtaji wa hisa ni TZS 300,000. Kubadili jina ni TZS 22,000.

Ada nyingine za kuwasilisha nyaraka BRELA: kuwasilisha memorandum na articles ni TZS 66,000; stempu kwa kila nakala ya memorandum TZS 10,000; fomu 14B TZS 1,200; kupokea/kusajili nyaraka TZS 22,000; kuthibitisha nyaraka kwa ukurasa TZS 3,000; kutafuta faili TZS 3,000 na ripoti ya utafutaji TZS 22,000; nakala iliyothibitishwa ya cheti cha usajili TZS 4,000. Kampuni ya kigeni (kifungu 12): kuwasilisha nyaraka USD 220, mizania USD 220, na faini ya kuchelewa USD 25 kwa mwezi.

Ada ya ukaguzi wa umeme OSHA kwa VITUO VYA MAFUTA VIJIJINI (majaribio manne: Polarity, Continuity, Earth Resistance, Insulation Test) ilipunguzwa mwaka 2025 kutoka TZS 650,000 hadi TZS 150,000 ili kuhamasisha uwekezaji vijijini. Hii SI ada ya jumla ya ukaguzi wa umeme kwa maeneo yote ya kazi -- kila kiwanda/eneo la kazi linalotumia umeme linahitajika kukaguliwa KILA MWAKA chini ya Cap.297 kifungu 66(2), kwa ada tofauti isiyothibitishwa (si TZS 650,000 wala 150,000).
